svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram name="Global Alarm" id="global_alarm"> <mxGraphModel dx="1188" dy="815" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="920" pageHeight="700" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=17;fontStyle=1" value="<b>The Global Alarm</b>
wave at House A's sensor → BOTH armed houses buzz" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="520" x="200" y="8" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="hA" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=12;align=center;" value="🏠 <b>House A</b> (ESP32)
🔒 alarm armed" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="180" x="50" y="62" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="hub" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=12;align=center;" value="🐍 <b>Hub</b> (Flask)
houses.py" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="180" x="370" y="62" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="hB" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=12;align=center;" value="🏠 <b>House B</b> (ESP32)
🔒 alarm armed" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="180" x="690" y="62" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="llA" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=none;dashed=1;strokeColor=#b85450;strokeWidth=2;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="140" y="112" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="140" y="600" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="llHub" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=none;dashed=1;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=2;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="460" y="112" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="460" y="600" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="llB" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=none;dashed=1;strokeColor=#b85450;strokeWidth=2;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="780" y="112" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="780" y="600" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="wave" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;align=left;" value="👋 <b>1.</b> You wave at House A's PIR
→ pin 0→1 fires the IRQ
→ motion flag set" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="56" width="210" x="40" y="122" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_report" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;fontFamily=Courier New;" value="<b>2.</b> POST /api/houses/A/report_motion"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="140" y="200" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="460" y="200" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="hubSet" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=11;align=center;" value="<b>3.</b> report_motion(A): A is armed →
set <b>alarm_triggered = True</b> on EVERY armed house" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="48" width="340" x="290" y="222" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_fanout" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=block;dashed=1;strokeColor=#9673a6;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=10;fontColor=#9673a6;" value="(internal: B is armed too → B's flag = True)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="460" y="290" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="780" y="290" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="bFlag" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=10;align=center;" value="🚩 alarm_triggered = True" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="26" width="180" x="690" y="300" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_kaA" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;fontFamily=Courier New;" value="<b>4.</b> PUT /A/keepalive (next tick, ~0.5s)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="140" y="350" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="460" y="350" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_respA" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=open;dashed=1;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;fontFamily=Courier New;" value="200 OK { alarm: TRUE } (clears A's flag — one-shot)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="460" y="382" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="140" y="382" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="aBuzz" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=12;align=center;" value="🔊 <b>5.</b> buzzer.on()" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="180" x="50" y="400" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_kaB" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#d6b656;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;fontFamily=Courier New;" value="<b>6.</b> PUT /B/keepalive (next tick, ~0.5s)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="780" y="470" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="460" y="470" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_respB" edge="1" parent="1" style="html=1;endArrow=open;dashed=1;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=11;fontFamily=Courier New;" value="200 OK { alarm: TRUE } (clears B's flag)"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="460" y="502" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="780" y="502" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="bBuzz" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=12;align=center;" value="🔊 <b>7.</b> buzzer.on()" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="180" x="690" y="520" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="footer" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontSize=11;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;" value="🔔 Both buzzers now stay ON until someone disarms. Worst-case delay from wave to the FARTHEST buzzer ≈ 1 second (A's report + B's keepalive interval). The 'one-shot' flag means each house buzzes once per motion event, not on every keepalive." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="840" x="40" y="580" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="legReq" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;fontSize=10;fontColor=#d6b656;" value="solid gold = request (house → hub)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="18" width="260" x="40" y="648" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="legResp" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;fontSize=10;fontColor=#82b366;" value="dashed green = response (hub → house)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="18" width="280" x="320" y="648" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="legInt" parent="1" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;fontSize=10;fontColor=#9673a6;" value="dashed purple = the hub's internal state change" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="18" width="290" x="610" y="648" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
